subject.title: Support Ultra thinking for the native Codex runtime

question: After fixing the non-escalating fallback, should Ultra remain a canonical persisted and plugin-facing OpenClaw thinking level?
rationale: The native Codex integration matches the upstream protocol, but the PR deliberately expands shared configuration, session, catalog, and plugin contracts and defines upgrade-visible cross-provider behavior.

options.title: Approve canonical Ultra
options.body: Keep the shared level after ensuring only an explicit Ultra request can activate Ultra and retain the documented downgrade behavior elsewhere.

options.title: Keep Ultra Codex-local
options.body: Narrow the implementation so general configuration, session, and plugin contracts never store or expose Ultra.

options.title: Defer Ultra support
options.body: Retain current Max behavior and revisit the broader contract after the specialized capability stabilizes.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical Ultra
recommendation.body: Keep the shared level after ensuring only an explicit Ultra request can activate Ultra and retain the documented downgrade behavior elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and owns the most relevant recent Codex app-server, provider-catalog, and thinking-policy history.
